blocks.title: Pehli electron affinity
blocks.text: Pehli electron affinity (delta H ea1) woh enthalpy change hai jo mayari halaat mein gaisi atoms ke 1 mole mein electrons ka 1 mole jor kar gaisi yak-manfi (uni-negative) ions ka 1 mole banane par hota hai.

Chlorine ke liye, Cl(g) + e- se Cl-(g), delta H ea1 = -348.8 kJ fi mol: woh tawanai jo gaisi halat mein 6.02 x 10 ki taqat 23 chlorine atoms ke chloride ions banne par kharij hoti hai. Chunke tawanai kharij hoti hai, pehli electron affinity manfi nishan rakhti hai. Doosri electron affinity (delta H ea2) woh tawanai hai jo mayari halaat mein yak-manfi gaisi ions ke 1 mole mein electrons jor kar gaisi 2- ions ka 1 mole banane ke liye darkar hai. Jab neutral oxygen atom mein pehla electron jurta hai to 141 kJ fi mol kharij hoti hai: O(g) + e- se O-(g), delta H ea1 = -141 kJ fi mol. Magar yak-manfi ion mein doosra electron jorne par 798 kJ fi mol jazb hoti hai: O-(g) + e- se O2-(g), delta H ea2 = +798 kJ fi mol. Oxide ion banne ka khalis enthalpy change majmua hai: O(g) + 2e- se O2-(g), (-141) + (+798) = +657 kJ fi mol.
Electron affinity par asar dalne wale awamil

items: Atom ki jasamat: chhote atoms ke liye aane wale electron par nucleus ki kashish zyada mazboot hai, to atom jitna chhota, us ki electron affinity utni zyada.
Nuclear charge: nuclear charge jitna zyada, aane wale electron ke liye kashish utni mazboot, to electron affinity nuclear charge ke saath barhti hai.

Electronic configuration: jab electron aadhe bhare subshell mein jura jaye to electron affinity kam hoti hai. Group 15 ke atoms nitrogen aur phosphorus (N = 2s2 2p3, P = 3s2 3p3) ki qeematein bohat kam hain kyunke un ke mustahkam aadhe bhare p subshells izafi electron qabool karne ka kam rujhan rakhte hain. Group 18 ki noble gases, mustahkam ns2 np6 configurations ke saath, izafi electron qabool nahin kartin, jaisa un ki musbat pehli electron affinities dikhati hain.

blocks.prompt: Samjhayein ke oxygen ki pehli electron affinity -141 kJ fi mol hai magar doosri musbat kyun, aur nitrogen ki electron affinity jasamat se umeed se kam kyun hai.
blocks.explanation: Pehla electron neutral atom ka nucleus kheenchta hai aur tawanai kharij hoti hai. Doosre ko pehle se manfi ion par us ki repulsion ke khilaf zabardasti jorna parta hai, to tawanai jazb hoti hai aur qeemat musbat hai (matn mein +798 kJ fi mol). Nitrogen ka 2p subshell bilkul aadha bhara hai, ek mustahkam tarteeb jo izafi electron lene ka kam rujhan rakhti hai, to chhoti jasamat ke bawajood us ki electron affinity bohat kam hai.

items: Pehli electron affinity: enthalpy change jab gaisi atoms ka ek mole electrons ka ek mole leta hai; tawanai kharij, to manfi (Cl -348.8, O -141 kJ fi mol). Doosri musbat hai (O- se O2-: +798; khalis +657).
Chhote atoms aur zyada nuclear charge ke liye zyada; aadhe bhare p subshells (N, P) ke liye bohat kam aur noble gases ke liye musbat.
